title: Incident Response Runbook
content:
Incident Response Runbook v1.5

The Incident Response Runbook is owned by the Security Team and maintained by the Site Reliability Engineering Team.

Incident Severity Levels:
- SEV1: Complete system outage affecting all users. Response time: 5 minutes.
- SEV2: Major feature degradation affecting more than 30% of users. Response time: 15 minutes.
- SEV3: Minor degradation affecting less than 30% of users. Response time: 1 hour.
- SEV4: Cosmetic issues with no user impact. Response time: next business day.

Incident Response Process:
1. Detection: Automated alerts trigger via PagerDuty
2. Triage: On-call engineer assesses severity within 5 minutes
3. Escalation: SEV1 incidents automatically page the Security Team Lead and Engineering Manager
4. Mitigation: Apply rollback, feature flag, or hotfix
5. Resolution: Confirm all systems operational
6. Post-mortem: Write incident report within 48 hours

The Security Team must be notified for any incident involving data breach, unauthorized access, or potential data exfiltration.

The Engineering Team owns the on-call rotation. Each engineer serves one week on-call per quarter.

Communication during incidents:
- Internal: Slack channel #incident-response
- External: Status page updates every 15 minutes for SEV1/SEV2
- Executive: Email to VP Engineering for SEV1 only

This runbook is reviewed monthly by the Security Team and Site Reliability Engineering Team.
